title: Law to raise income limits for senior and disabled homeowner tax breaks
summary: This bill would raise the income threshold for the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption (SCHE) and Disabled Homeowners' Exemption (DHE) from $50,000 to $75,000 starting July 1, 2027, with updated sliding-scale exemption schedules. It would also raise the maximum SCHE exemption from 50 percent to 65 percent. Under the new schedule, homeowners earning under $72,000 could get a 65 percent exemption, while those earning up to $83,400 could still get a partial exemption.
